a0c81b31: ;
This routine initiates printing of Patient Treatment File Report.
;It prompts for sorting method - either by Physician or Specialty.
;It also prompts for whether to print report for Inpatients,
;Outpatients or Both.
6abfb045: ;If user enters nothing or P/p, default to Physician sort.
87e3a53e: ;If user enters S/s, sort by Specialty.
4d0f870f: ;If user enters ?, display help on sorting options.
e3d4c481: ;If invalid sort option entered, display sorting options again.
6a5ea50c: ;If user enters nothing or B/b, default to Both inpatients and outpatients.

e01e3160: ;If user enters I/i, print report for Inpatients only.
;If user enters O/o, print report for Outpatients only.
84012688: ;If user enters ?, display help on inpatient/outpatient options.
5e139787: ;If invalid inpatient/outpatient option entered, display options again.
db861a50: ;If user selects 'B' for both, or presses Enter with no input, set X to 3.
df1f05e1: ;Convert user input to numeric value: 1 for 'P' (Patient Lists), 2 for 'T' (Totals Page), or retain original value if not 'P' or 'T'.
5eba706a: ;If user enters '?', display help and return to prompt.
0ca9ea59: ;If user input is invalid, display help and return to prompt.
05a03bed: ;If GL node exists in ^DG(43,1) (indicating Mult-Dist Division), set DGJTMUL to value from GL node.
ed72bd9c: ;Set DGJTL based on DGJTSR value: 'PHY' for 1, 'SER' for 2, or 'QUIT' for other values.
751eeb25: ;Set DGJTSTAT to string containing internal entry numbers for 'INCOMPLETE', 'DICTATED', 'TRANSCRIBED', and 'SIGNED' statuses.
0bf64d26: ;Branch to ^DGJOTP1 to continue processing.

c051315f: ;FileMan stores dates using $H format, so add fraction .9999 to ensure entire day is included
